# controlnet_pair: same-generator ControlNet pedestrian pairs on real WOD

status: concluded
decisions: 59
headline: Paused, not no-go: user judged deletion unclean and insertion somewhat fake on 19 scenes; no automatic checks run

**Question.** Can both sides of a real-clip pair be generated by the same ControlNet-style model (Cosmos-Transfer2.5 Edge Distilled, controls from one WOD clip with the target pedestrian removed from x-) so generator artifacts cancel?

**Conclusion.** Paused, not no-go (decisions 59, confirmed): on 19 scenes the user judged deletion not clean and insertion somewhat fake but acceptable, so the line stopped. Only Edge Distilled was tried (base + vis on one scene), and no automatic checks were run, so "this route cannot make clean deletion pairs" is a conjecture. Restart condition: real-appearance pairs are needed that CARLA pairs (cosmos G4) cannot cover; then add an automatic detector-recall check (< 5%) on the deleted region first.

**Read more.** research/controlnet-pair-pilot.md, research/survey-counterfactual-video-gen.md, `git show bcbdde4:tmp/2026-09-29-controlnet-pair-handoff.md`
